response.sql: SELECT SUM(g - l) AS total_g_minus_l, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half WHERE w > 26;

assumptions.assumption: "Pass the 26-win mark" means strictly more than 26 wins (w > 26). Records with NULL w are excluded by the comparison.
"Ignoring missing values" applies to the sum: SUM skips any row where g - l is NULL. The record count is all matching rows, including rows where g or l is missing.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only the records whose g - l is non-missing, so the count matches the rows that contribute to the total.
alternatives.sql: SELECT SUM(g - l) AS total_g_minus_l, COUNT(g - l) AS record_count FROM manager_half WHERE w > 26;
